def nw(s1,s2,go=-11.,ge=-1.):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    tM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);tX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);tY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0.;X[1:,0]=0.;Y[0,1:]=0.;tX[1:,0]=1;tY[0,1:]=2
    S=np.array([[BL.get((a,b),-4) for b in s2] for a in s1],float)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        pM,pX,pY=M[i-1],X[i-1],Y[i-1];Mi,Xi,Yi=M[i],X[i],Y[i];Si=S[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a,b,c=pM[j-1],pX[j-1],pY[j-1]
            if a>=b and a>=c: Mi[j]=a+Si[j-1];tM[i,j]=0
            elif b>=c: Mi[j]=b+Si[j-1];tM[i,j]=1
            else: Mi[j]=c+Si[j-1];tM[i,j]=2
            a,b,c=pM[j]+go,pX[j]+ge,pY[j]+go
            if a>=b and a>=c: Xi[j]=a;tX[i,j]=0
            elif b>=c: Xi[j]=b;tX[i,j]=1
            else: Xi[j]=c;tX[i,j]=2
            a,b,c=Mi[j-1]+go,Xi[j-1]+go,Yi[j-1]+ge
            if a>=b and a>=c: Yi[j]=a;tY[i,j]=0
            elif b>=c: Yi[j]=b;tY[i,j]=1
            else: Yi[j]=c;tY[i,j]=2
    best=(-1e18,0,0,0)
    for i in range(n+1):
        for st,arr in ((0,M),(1,X),(2,Y)):
            if arr[i,m]>best[0]: best=(arr[i,m],i,m,st)
    for j in range(m+1):
        for st,arr in ((0,M),(1,X),(2,Y)):
            if arr[n,j]>best[0]: best=(arr[n,j],n,j,st)
    sc,i,j,st=best;a1=[];a2=[]
    for k in range(n,i,-1): a1.append(s1[k-1]);a2.append('-')
    for k in range(m,j,-1): a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[k-1])
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if st==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append(s2[j-1]);st=tM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');st=tX[i,j];i-=1
        else: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);st=tY[i,j];j-=1
    while i>0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');i-=1
    while j>0: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1
    return sc,''.join(reversed(a1)),''.join(reversed(a2))
def getseq(a):
    t=requests.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta',timeout=60).text.strip().split('\n')
    return ''.join(t[1:])
